_comment: The perf rubric, read by tools/perf/grade.py and by the test page (perf.js, to stop the ladder). docs/perf.md cites each source. Change on purpose, with the docs and the tests.

frame_p95_ms.source: web.dev RAIL (16 ms frame budget); Android vitals slow frame (> 16 ms). One and two frames at 60 Hz, plus 0.5 ms slack

frame_jank_pct.source: good: same as p95 within budget (derived); poor: Play Console 'excessive slow frames' (> 50% over 16 ms)

frame_frozen_pct.source: Android vitals frozen frame (> 700 ms); poor: Play Console 'excessive frozen frames' (> 0.1%); good 0%: project choice

load_ms.source: Core Web Vitals LCP bounds (good <= 2.5 s, poor > 4 s), applied to the reference dashboard from navigation start to the last frame before 750 ms of quiet (at least as late as its LCP, so stricter)

inp_ms.source: Core Web Vitals INP (good <= 200 ms, poor > 500 ms)

start_ms.source: app process start to the reference dashboard's first contentful paint. poor: Android vitals' excessive cold start bound (>= 5 s), which vitals apply to TTID; here it applies to a later point, so stricter. good <= 2.5 s: project choice (LCP's bound)

js_burst_ms.source: project choice: one state burst fits in a frame; poor past RAIL's 50 ms input budget
